mapper.select: SELECT ts.id AS slotId, ts.name AS slotName, ts.start_time AS startTime, ts.end_time AS endTime, c.total AS total, IFNULL(o.occupied, 0) AS occupied FROM time_slot ts CROSS JOIN (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM seat WHERE room_id = #{roomId} AND status = 1 AND deleted = 0) c LEFT JOIN (SELECT r.slot_id, COUNT(DISTINCT r.seat_id) AS occupied FROM reservation r WHERE r.room_id = #{roomId} AND r.reserve_date = #{date} AND r.status <> 4 GROUP BY r.slot_id) o ON o.slot_id = ts.id WHERE ts.status = 1 ORDER BY ts.slot_no

SELECT r.reserve_date AS reserveDate, COUNT(*) AS totalCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN r.status IN (2, 3) THEN 1 END) AS checkedInCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN r.status = 4 THEN 1 END) AS cancelledCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN r.status = 5 THEN 1 END) AS violationCount FROM reservation r WHERE r.reserve_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY r.reserve_date ORDER BY r.reserve_date
